The '''Merel sector''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Lol sector/Legends|Lol sector]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]], the [[Samix sector/Legends|Samix sector]] Rimward, and the [[Skine sector/Legends|Skine sector]] in the [[trailing]] direction. The [[Nedij system/Legends|Nedij system]]<ref name="EAOC Outer Rim" /> of the Samix [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> was located very close to the Merel-Samix border.<ref name="EAOC Outer Rim" />

The [[Ragnar system/Legends|Ragnar system]] was situated in the Merel sector,<ref name="EAOC" /> and the former contained the remote astronomical object [[Ragnar VIII]].<ref name="Journal15">{{JournalCite|15|Special Military Unit Intelligence Update}}</ref> The home offices of the [[Ragnar Syndicate]], a chapter house of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]], were located on Ragnar VIII, leading to the celestial body being considered the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the house.<ref name="GG10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Merel sector was governed by Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tregar]], who often employed the Ragnar Syndicate for missions unfit for the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].<ref name="GG9" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] carried out operations in the sector.<ref name="RECG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Merel sector was first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', a [[1993]] sourcebook written by [[Simon Smith]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG9" /> In [[2012]], the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in [https://web.archive.org/web/20180325111127/https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors], a feature of<ref name="EAOC Outer Rim" /> the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC" /> The map placed it in grid squares Q-18 and Q-19.<ref name="EAOC Outer Rim" />
